senses.gloss: (In music) A kind of gait or movement.

[मेनकायां भवः अण्] N. of a mountain, son of Himālaya and Menā, who alone retained his wings (when Indra clipped those of other mountains) on account of his friendship with the ocean; cf. [[Ku. 1. 20]]; चिरं जलनिधौ मग्नो मैनाक इव मार्दवम् [[Bv.]] 
-Comp. 
-स्वसृ f. epithet of Pārvatī.

N. of a demon killed by Kṛṣṇa. 
-Comp. 
-हन् m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
